product_one_liner.value: Dengage helps marketers unify customer data, orchestrate personalized omnichannel campaigns, and measure customer engagement across digital touchpoints.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes enabling marketers to unify customer data, orchestrate personalized campaigns and measure results across email, SMS, push, WhatsApp, onsite and in-app touchpoints.

pricing_page.notes: Dengage has a publicly accessible pricing page at https://dengage.com/pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The official customer-stories page links a Burgan Bank case study and describes Nishat using Dengage's platform. | named_customers.0: Burgan Bank appears on Dengage's official customer-stories page with a linked case study. | named_customers.1: The customer story explicitly describes Nishat using Dengage's platform.

employee_band.notes: The official about page reports 170+ employees, supporting the 101-200 band as an approximate classification rather than an exact headcount.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company profile explicitly identifies London as the headquarters city. | hq_country: The company profile explicitly identifies its headquarters as London, United Kingdom.

founded_year.notes: The company-issued announcement explicitly states that Dengage was founded in 2018.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog index presents marketing guidance and product updates. It did not establish two engineer-authored posts explaining how Dengage is built, so it does not qualify as an engineering blog under the requested definition.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation index at https://dev.dengage.com/docs contains numerous linked articles, including AI Text Creation, AI Design Studio and ZekiAI Translator.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The official current-openings board lists Full Stack Developer and Software Engineering Intern roles. Neither title meets the specified AI, ML or data-science criteria.

model_provider.notes: The AI product page and FAQ, generative-AI documentation, assistant documentation, blog, trust page and subprocessor list were inspected. They describe Zeki-branded features and AI capabilities but did not identify an underlying model or model provider. Cloud hosting alone was not treated as model-provider evidence.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The official trust page claims SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 and GDPR compliance. Only the requested frameworks are included; ISO 27701 and KVKK are excluded. | compliance_certs.0: The official trust page explicitly claims SOC 2 Type II compliance. | compliance_certs.1: The official trust page explicitly claims ISO 27001 compliance. | compliance_certs.2: The official trust page explicitly claims GDPR compliance; it is included because GDPR is one of the requested frameworks.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The funding profile classifies the September 2025 round as Seed. Classification is uncertain: another tracker calls it Series A, while the company announcement describes only a strategic investment without specifying a stage. | funding_date: The company announcement is dated September 3, 2025, matching the funding profile's latest-round date. Another tracker uses September 8; both support the requested month, 2025-09. | funding_amount_usd: The funding profile explicitly describes the recorded round amounts as undisclosed, and the company announcement does not disclose an amount. Null therefore means undisclosed, not zero funding.

raised_18mo.notes: The company announced that it secured investment on September 3, 2025, within the eighteen months preceding November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: An accessible Business Development Representative–Lebanon posting, dated August 31, 2026, offers an application option. This is a qualifying sales role, although it is not shown on the shorter careers-board index.

launched_6mo.notes: A substantial gamification feature is documented, but the changelog provides only the relative date '6 months ago.' An exact publication date could not be established, so placement before or after the May 9, 2026 cutoff remains unknown; neither true nor false is asserted.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Mirza Mansoor Baig's profile records a Dengage VP of Customer Experience role beginning December 1, 2025, within the requested twelve-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The BDR posting explicitly instructs employees to source prospects in Apollo, synchronize lists to Zoho CRM and keep Zoho accurate. These are operational-use signals, not merely optional familiarity requirements. | crm_stack_signal.0: The job description requires maintaining Zoho and reporting funnel progress, directly indicating CRM use. | crm_stack_signal.1: The job description instructs the BDR to find target companies and decision-makers in Apollo.
